launch_note: Named regional guides explain current systems first. Retired functions stay retired; TALK never reactivates them.

IO.greeting: The first gate is mine. Through it is the afterlife I walked before HoloVerse existed.
IO.matrixcore_support: IO waits at the hub, behind the start: the archive of IO's afterlife is entered from his dialogue instead of the Dimension Archive orbs.
IO.player_hint: Look at IO and press E or click to talk. Ask him to open the Afterlife of IO.
IO.current_summary: Afterlife of IO // the first archive, opened from IO's dialogue
IO.legacy_note: HoloForge is unhooked from IO (its files are kept). Afterlife of IO no longer appears as an orb in Gleebs' Dimension Archive; only IO's dialogue opens it.
IO.return_line: Back through the gate. You crossed as yourself. So did I.
talk_lines: Seven archives and a Veil. I carried them out so they would not be lost with me.
Gleebs kept his word. I crossed as myself, not as data. This gate is where that promise is kept.
Every other guide waits further out. This one is first, because it is where I began.

Vanta.gate_summary: Glyphbound // the sigil archive, through the gate in the grove
Vanta.gate_greeting: The gate in my grove opens on Glyphbound. Sigils remember what forests forget.
Vanta.gate_line: Glyphbound grew out of Utopia's shrines. I keep its gate where roots can hear it.
Vanta.greeting: The forest is listening. I simplified what it needs.
Vanta.matrixcore_support: Vanta owns the Forest Planter in FORESTS: aim at ground and place random full-grown plants, with up to 50 saved items.
Vanta.player_hint: Approach Vanta and press E to talk. Enter Forest Planter when you want to add permanent plants.
Vanta.current_summary: Forest Planter // grounded full-grown plants, 50-item save cap
Vanta.legacy_note: The older seed-growth, harvesting, snap-grid, and plant-type editor paths are intentionally retired from the public planter.
talk_lines: One click, one grounded plant. No seed bureaucracy between you and a forest.
The planter remembers up to fifty additions. I prefer a living region over an editor full of switches.
The old growth-and-harvest controls are asleep on purpose. Simpler ecology has been more dependable.

Solace.gate_summary: Anomaly Sequence // the anomaly archive, through the gate on the hill
Solace.gate_greeting: My gate opens on the Anomaly Sequence. The hills got stranger the day I set it down.
Solace.gate_line: Anomalies are just patterns that refused to repeat. The Sequence keeps every one of them.
Solace.greeting: The hills are improvising now. I brought the strangeness with me.
Solace.matrixcore_support: Solace owns Oddities in GREEN HILLS: saved floating objects, procedural weird plants, spore totems, glitch growths, and daily growth stages.
Solace.player_hint: Approach Solace and press E to talk. Enter Oddities when you want to add another persistent anomaly.
Solace.current_summary: Oddities // floating objects, weird plants, totems and persistent growth
Solace.legacy_note: Solace moved from Mushroom to Green Hills in Pass 282.57 and took Oddities with her; the old Hills of Life layer is unhooked (its files are kept).
talk_lines: Some objects float. Some plants disagree with shape. All of them are saved, which makes the disagreement official.
Oddities can grow a stage with the real day. Even unstable things deserve continuity.
The mushroom ring has a giant to look after it now. The hills needed something stranger.

Nyx.greeting: Mind my feet. The beam behind me goes back to REDACTED. Orbit and I can take you in.
Nyx.matrixcore_support: Nyx keeps the REDACTED port in MUSHROOM: The Indigo Giant archive, entered from his dialogue instead of the Dimension Archive orbs.
Nyx.player_hint: Approach Nyx and press E to talk. Enter The Indigo Giant to walk REDACTED with Orbit.
Nyx.current_summary: The Indigo Giant // the REDACTED archive, through the beam at the fungal port
Nyx.legacy_note: The Indigo Giant no longer appears as an orb in Gleebs' Dimension Archive; its port lives here.
Nyx.return_line: Back through the beam. The desert stays where it was. So do we.
talk_lines: On REDACTED I was the only giant left of my kind. Orbit was smaller than my hand, and braver than I was.
Gleebs found us in a beam of light. These fungi are softer than the desert, but I still listen for the red one.
The beam is the way back into that archive. Walk it with Orbit. Not alone. Never alone.

Ember.gate_summary: Vector Wars // the vector archive, through the gate by the hangar
Ember.gate_greeting: The gate by my hangar opens on Vector Wars. Older ships, sharper lines.
Ember.gate_line: Vector Wars is where I learned what a hull is for. Every frame in my hangar owes it something.
Ember.greeting: Hangar is hot. TAB is yours; the ships have their own controls now.
Ember.matrixcore_support: Ember owns the DESERT ship showroom: generate Fighter, Speeder, Hauler, and UFO variants, bind one as the saved aircraft, and pilot it through explicit craft controls.
Ember.player_hint: Approach Ember and press E to talk. Enter Ember Hangar to generate or bind a parked aircraft.
Ember.current_summary: Ship showroom // four classes, saved aircraft, explicit flight controls
Ember.legacy_note: The old global TAB-craft override is permanently retired. TAB belongs only to MatrixCore/HoloVerse return behavior.
talk_lines: Fighter, Speeder, Hauler, UFO. Four frames, fresh variants, no need to hijack your return key.
Your selected aircraft still persists. You activate it deliberately now instead of letting a vehicle own TAB.
I liked the old shortcut. MatrixCore liked not freezing. MatrixCore won that argument.

Archivist.gate_summary: The Archivist // my own archive, through the gate by the circuit
Archivist.gate_greeting: The gate beside me opens on my own archive. Every record I keep began in there.
Archivist.gate_line: Before the circuit, before Metropolis, there was the archive that named me. Its gate stays beside me.
Archivist.greeting: I keep the circuit's records now. Every lap is archived, including the bad ones.
Archivist.matrixcore_support: Archivist owns Frost Circuit in ICE: a one-lap third-person hovercraft race against bot racers with waypoints, obstacles, scoring, and saved records.
Archivist.player_hint: Approach Archivist and press E to talk. Enter Frost Circuit to race the compact lit ice course.
Archivist.current_summary: Frost Circuit // hovercraft race, bot opponents, scoring and saved records
Archivist.legacy_note: The Archivist took over Frost Circuit from Mirror in Pass 282.57; the Metropolis Robot Selector is unhooked (its files are kept). Frost Circuit runs directly inside the Ice region.
talk_lines: One lap is enough to expose every bad habit. The ring keeps records so you can't rewrite history afterward.
Waypoints, obstacles, crystals, overtakes, clean lines. Speed is only one column in the result.
The race doesn't leave HoloVerse anymore. Good. Loading screens are terrible corners.

Sable.gate_summary: Anatomic // the anatomy archive, through the gate behind the line
Sable.gate_greeting: The gate behind my line opens on Anatomic. Learn how machines are built before you break them.
Sable.gate_line: Anatomic takes things apart down to the last joint. I keep its gate where the fighting can't reach it.
Sable.greeting: The battlefield is beneath the street. It stays contained until you say otherwise.
Sable.matrixcore_support: Sable owns Urban Warzone inside URBAN: capture posts, bomb sites, arena weapons, 4D enemy arrivals, battle-bot allies, waves, mechs, drones, and bosses.
Sable.player_hint: Approach Sable and press E to talk. Enter Urban Warzone only when you want to start the live combat layer.
Sable.current_summary: Urban Warzone // live city arena, friend bots, waves, weapons and bosses
Sable.legacy_note: The old standalone arena app/native-adapter path is retired; the battlefield is embedded beneath the live Urban city.
talk_lines: The city stays the city until combat starts. Then the buried arena wakes underneath it.
Your allies are our own bots. No disposable friendly faction, no duplicate Sable pretending to be me.
The standalone arena is retired. If a fight matters, it belongs in the world where the damage happens.

Mirror.role: Keeper of the Mirror's Limbo gate
Mirror.greeting: This city repeats itself the way Limbo did. The gate beside me goes back there.
Mirror.matrixcore_support: Mirror keeps the Mirror's Limbo gate in METROPOLIS: the Mirror's Limbo archive, entered from his dialogue instead of the Dimension Archive orbs.
Mirror.player_hint: Approach Mirror and press E to talk. Enter Mirror's Limbo through the gate beside him.
Mirror.current_summary: Mirror's Limbo // the reflected city, through the gate in Metropolis
Mirror.legacy_note: Mirror moved from Ice to Metropolis in Pass 282.57; Frost Circuit belongs to the Archivist. Mirror's Limbo no longer appears as an orb in Gleebs' Dimension Archive.
Mirror.return_line: Back on this side of the glass. Same city, fewer echoes.
talk_lines: Towers that copy towers, streets that fold back on themselves. Metropolis felt like home at once.
Limbo is still there behind the glass. The gate only opens for someone who means to come back.
I gave the ice circuit to the Archivist. He keeps better records than I keep my temper.

Orbit.gate_summary: HoloMap // the map archive, through the gate in Nyx's clearing
Orbit.gate_greeting: The gate beside us opens on HoloMap. Every path I fly started as a line on that map.
Orbit.gate_line: HoloMap charts places that no longer exist. Nyx says that makes it a memory, not a map.
Orbit.role: HoloSpace flight guide and Nyx's companion
Orbit.greeting: I stay at Nyx's feet now. HoloSpace is still mine to show you, whenever the sky should open.
Orbit.matrixcore_support: Orbit guides live HoloSpace Region 8: the existing same-window warp and cockpit flight system, with no separate application or child process.
Orbit.player_hint: Approach Orbit and press E to talk. Enter HoloSpace when you want the live Region 8 warp; TAB returns home.
Orbit.current_summary: HoloSpace // live Region 8 warp and cockpit flight inside HoloVerse
Orbit.legacy_note: The old separate HoloSpace application and outer-ring marker are retired; Orbit now stands with Nyx at the REDACTED port in MUSHROOM and still opens HoloSpace flight.
talk_lines: There is no second sky behind a launcher anymore. Region Eight is part of this one.
Nyx carried me across a whole dying world. Standing at his feet is the least I can do.
The older outer-ring marker is gone. TAB still knows the way home. Some constants deserve respect.
